subject: Post-demo security recap + SOC 2 Type II / portal access next steps
messages:
From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Kim <lara.kim@clearpointhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 10:12:00 -0700
Subject: Post-demo recap: SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA scope & next steps

Hi Lara —

Thanks again for taking the demo this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum: 

Summary from call:
- Primary use case: PHI-containing summaries for care coordination (HIPAA scope required).
- Key asks: current SOC 2 Type II report, a bridge letter that covers the date gap if any, and trust portal access to upload evidence.
- Residency: prefer US-only processing for now; we discussed our dedicated region options.

Proposed next steps:
1) Can you share the procurement contact who will receive the SOC 2 and SLA? I’ve CC'd procurement in case you want to loop them directly.
2) We’ll initiate the vendor security questionnaire (DSQ) from our side — you’ll get an intake link. Please delegate to your security reviewer.
3) If you can grant trust portal access (or confirm the email to invite), we’ll upload the current SOC 2 Type II and a redwood bridge letter template.
4) Quick follow-up call: do mornings on Friday (7/23) work for a 30-min status/contract sync?

Attachments: redwood-demo-deck.pdf (deck we walked through)

I’ll start the DSQ and follow up when the portal invite is sent.

Best,
Mateo
Business Development | Redwood Inference
mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0192

From: Lara Kim <lara.kim@clearpointhealth.com>
To: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
Cc: Procurement <procurement@clearpointhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 21 Jul 2027 14:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA scope & next steps

Thanks Mateo — great demo and appreciate the clear list. A few items from our side: 

1) Procurement contact: Jordan Pierce (procurement@clearpointhealth.com).
2) SOC 2: we'd like to review the Type II report and an accompanying bridge letter if the report date does not cover production start. If you already have the report in the portal, please invite jordan and me.
3) HIPAA: we need confirmation on BAAs and the expected data flows. Can you point to a BAA template or confirm your process for signed BAAs?
4) Timeline: procurement will prioritize security review but expects 7-10 business days after receipt of documents and completed DSQ.

I attached a draft SLA that our procurement team will expect you to review (see attached). Also attaching our preliminary inventory spreadsheet to help scope the DSQ.

Attachments: clearpoint-sla-draft.pdf, clearpoint-dsq-inventory.xlsx

Please route the trust portal invite to jordan.procurement@clearpointhealth.com and lara.kim@clearpointhealth.com.

Thanks,
Lara Kim
Head of Security, Clearpoint Health
lara.kim@clearpointhealth.com

From: Mateo Alvarez <mateo_alvarez@redwood.ai>
To: Lara Kim <lara.kim@clearpointhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Evelyn Hart <evelyn_hart@redwood.ai>, Jordan Pierce <procurement@clearpointhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 22 Jul 2027 08:29:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Post-demo recap: SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA scope & next steps

Hi Lara / Jordan —

Thanks — we’ll do the following immediately: 
- Start DSQ intake and send the secure link (you should see the DSQ invite from security@redwood.ai within the hour).
- Ben will upload our latest SOC 2 Type II into the trust portal and invite both of you.
- We’ll include our standard BAA template and a short note on data residency and processing in the portal. If the SOC 2 date doesn’t fully cover your go-live target we’ll provide a bridge letter; Ben is looping in the template.

Proposed follow-up call: Fri 23 Jul at 09:30 PT — 30 minutes to align procurement + security. If that works I’ll send a calendar invite.

Action owners:
- Mateo: DSQ invite + calendar invite
- Ben: portal upload + bridge letter template
- Evelyn (Solution Architect): finalize HIPAA scoping notes and BAA pointer

Thanks — we’ll be in touch shortly.

Regards,
Mateo

Portal access: https://trust.redwood.ai/portal/CLP-2027 (invites sent)
Bridge letter: attached (redwood-bridge-letter-template.pdf). This is a standard attestation that covers control coverage through the current report date and notes any changes since issuance — we tailor it to the customer's go-live date.

BAA & HIPAA notes: Evelyn will follow up with a short doc outlining how PHI is handled, our BAA template, and the specific processing options for US-only routing. Expect that in your inbox within the next business day.

Next steps from here:
- Jordan/procurement: let us know procurement SLAs or required edits to the SLA draft.
